name: @floor/cluster-agent
description: Claims station_run.dispatch and station_run.abort events by tag and turns them into ai-agent-subsystem Agent custom resources — the only process in this deployment that talks to a given cluster's Kubernetes API. Standalone this is one instance pointed at minikube; inside lore, cluster agents per cluster. Ported from lore's @re-cinq/lore-cluster-agent (kube-clients.ts, kube-agent-api.ts, k8s-errors.ts, the read-modify-replace Secret writer, the poll-loop and claim-loop shape) and adapted: lore watches Agent CRs for terminal status and reports through a separate event; here the pod's own supervisor streams straight to the Floor's sink (docs/assembly_run_storage.md, "the agent kind runs on the ai-agent-subsystem"), so this agent only creates and deletes CRs, it never watches them. The dispatch payload maps a Brief onto the AgentDefinition + Station + Agent triple per docs/entities/station.md's table.
